title: Deciding to go public; Kasparov calls for his removal

tellings.quote: The 13th World Chess Champion, Gary Kasparov, immediately began to state, "What kind of president of the World Chess Federation can Kersonen be? If he has met with aliens, he must be removed and replaced.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, then president of the Russian republic of Kalmykia and head of the World Chess Federation, says he was taken by aliens in 1997 and decided to speak about it in public. He says the 13th world chess champion, Garry Kasparov, at once asked what kind of chess federation president could have met aliens, and called for him to be removed and replaced. It is his own account, and it shows the price he says he paid for going public.
